setup_batch_predict_server: setup a Ray Serve deployment for batched MLIP inference with configurable batch size and OOM splitting
BatchPredictServer_predict: predict on a batch of AtomicData objects with automatic OOM recovery and batch splitting
BatchPredictServer_call: call the batch predict server with a single AtomicData object to get a prediction dictionary
BatchPredictServer_configure_batching: configure the batch size and wait timeout for the batch predict server deployment
BatchPredictServer_split_predictions: split batched prediction tensors back into individual system prediction dictionaries
